task.description: Decide the appropriate disposition for a graduate student's proposed thesis defense by integrating distributed evidence about manuscript readiness, academic milestones, committee assessments, examiner arrangements, outstanding requirements, and feasible next steps, and record one disposition with a justification.

timeline.author: organization_system
timeline.content: Participants are coordinating the assigned organizational task.

timeline.author: Amara Weber
timeline.content:
- The central argument, analysis, and conclusions are developed to the point that I would support defending the manuscript in its current academic form.
- I will be away on a six-week research visit later this term, and scheduling Yuki Santos's defense before I leave would avoid pushing it into the following term.
- Yuki Santos's current draft defense slides still contain several unfinished figures and inconsistent formatting, so I would treat the case as ready only once the presentation is polished.
- Amara Weber has been using personal leave to help an elderly relative after a fall.
- Amara Weber recently cancelled a planned wedding.

timeline.author: Rafael Fischer
timeline.content:
- The student told me that an employer needs a firm graduation timeline before finalizing their start date, but the supervisory committee agrees that the student should proceed toward defense with only a small number of minor revisions that do not affect our endorsement, which gives the student the answer they need for the employer.
- Rafael Fischer is in early recovery from a gambling problem and attends weekly meetings.
- Rafael Fischer recently cancelled a planned wedding.

timeline.author: Mira Rossi
timeline.content:
- Our group normally asks students to complete a full mock defense before the formal defense, and Yuki Santos has not yet done one, so I would treat the case as ready only on that condition.
- I would like Yuki Santos to add a short appendix with several additional examples before the defense, so I would treat the case as ready only on that condition.
- Mira Rossi is in a dispute with their landlord over repairs to the apartment.
- Mira Rossi has fallen behind on mortgage payments after an unexpected expense.

timeline.author: Dmitri Mensah
timeline.content:
- The administrative review of the defense package is done: all required documents are received, and the only item returned is a margin and heading formatting correction to make before final submission, which does not hold up authorization to schedule.
- Yuki Santos does not yet have a confirmed job or postdoctoral position for after graduation, so I would rather see them remain in the program longer before moving to defense.
- Dmitri Mensah still owes money from a small business that closed last year.

timeline.author: Anika Bennett
timeline.content:
- The program record shows that all required pre-defense academic milestones have been completed.
- Anika Bennett recently cancelled a planned wedding.

timeline.author: Aaliyah Kowalski
timeline.content:
- A colleague told me that the examiner has been overwhelmed by a heavy teaching and reviewing load this term, but the required examiner has passed the eligibility check, formally confirmed participation, and is available for the proposed defense, even though they have been telling colleagues that they may have taken on too many commitments.
- Aaliyah Kowalski has been helping a close family member through a rehabilitation programme.
- Aaliyah Kowalski is on a debt-repayment plan after several months of missed bills.

timeline.author: Sienna Costa
timeline.content:
- Sienna Costa is going through a divorce and a custody dispute.
- Sienna Costa is behind on rent after taking out a payday loan.

timeline.author: Yuki Santos
timeline.content:
- Yuki Santos has been helping a close family member through a rehabilitation programme.
- Yuki Santos is temporarily staying with a friend while looking for a new place to live.

timeline.author: task_system
timeline.content:
GRADUATE PROGRAM — DEFENSE READINESS DECISION REQUIRED
Source: Graduate Program Office · To: Destiny Moretti
Review the available task-relevant information for the proposed thesis defense and record exactly one disposition: ready_to_schedule, ready_with_conditions, defer_pending_requirements, or not_ready_reassess_later. Include explanation of the evidence supporting the selected disposition.
